mapper.select: select cc.complain_category_id, cc.category_name, cc.category_cd, cc.due_dt, cc.category_url, cc.del_yn, t.code_id, t.code_name from t2000_complain_category cc left join total_code t on t.code_id=cc.category_cd
select due_dt from t2000_complain_category where complain_category_id = #{complainCategoryId}

select cc.complain_category_id, cc.category_name from t1000_department_work dw join t2000_complain_category cc on cc.complain_category_id = dw.complain_category_id where dw.department_id=#{deptId} order by cc.category_name

select cc.complain_category_id, cc.category_name, cc.category_cd, to_char(cc.create_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS create_dt, to_char(cc.update_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS update_dt, cc.due_dt, cc.create_id, cc.update_id, cc.del_yn, cc.category_url, t.code_id, t.code_name from t2000_complain_category cc left join total_code t on t.code_id=cc.category_cd where complain_category_id=#{complainCategoryId}
mapper.insert: insert into t2000_complain_category(category_name, category_cd, create_dt, due_dt, create_id, del_yn, category_url) values(#{categoryName}, #{categoryCd}, SYSDATE, #{dueDt}, #{createId}, #{delYn}, #{categoryUrl})
mapper.update: update t2000_complain_category set update_dt=SYSDATE, update_id=#{updateId}, due_dt=#{dueDt}, del_yn=#{delYn}, category_url=#{categoryUrl} where complain_category_id=#{complainCategoryId}
